The Summer Solstice is a time of brightness, abundance, and expansion. As the sun reaches its peak, it invites us to open our hearts and share our own light.

In shamanic tradition, everyone has the power to bless. This simple ritual helps you welcome joy, love, and high-vibe energy into your life this season.


—with love, Donnie

The Seeds of Radiance
 Bracelet — Sunstone

You’ll need:
    •    A few fresh roses (any color)
    •    A bowl of water or mason jar
    •    A candle
    •    Optional: a few drops of rose oil

Step 1: Set the space
Find a quiet moment near a window or outside in the sun. Light your candle and take a few deep breaths.
Say:
“I welcome the light of this season. I open to love, joy, and high vibration.”

Step 2: Bless the roses
Hold a rose and speak a blessing:
“I bless you, and all you represent—beauty, love, and life.”
Place the rose in the water. Repeat with each one.

Step 3: Bless yourself
Dip your fingers in the rose water. Touch your forehead, heart, and hands.
Say:
“I bless my thoughts, my heart, and my actions. May I be a source of goodness.”

Step 4: Bless your life
Use the rose water to gently touch your front door, a photo of someone you love, your journal—anything meaningful.
Say:
“I choose to see the sacred in all things. I send blessings wherever they’re needed.”

Step 5: Carry it forward
This week, bless the flowers you see. Bless your home with gentle words. Bless your day with intention. The more you bless, the more beauty you invite in.

Since ancient times, amulets, stones, and metals have been used to guard the spirit, deflect harm, and strengthen the wearer’s power. Whether you need aura protection, psychic protection, boundary protection, or simply good energy hygiene, these are your modern talismans for energetic resilience.

This seconds long practice, adapted from the Donna Eden
“Zip Up Technique,” is a powerful way to seal your aura:
With one hand a few inches from your body, trace upward from your lower belly to the top of your head, then over your crown and down the back of your head (as if zipping up an invisible zipper).
Repeat three times, each time setting the intention to seal and strengthen your energy field.
Know that your energy field is sealed and protected.
